_comment: M7-16 counted-series retune (thief side): evolve ThiefBrain UNDER THE PAIR-LOCKED PHYSICS (multiplicative_book_v1) against a POOL of belief-driven cops. The M7-14 belief fix made the plain argmax chaser the strongest measured book-v1 cop (63/128 in the cop repo's arena), and the deployed reference-tuned thief survives only 5/16 against it - the M7-13 postmortem's warning (camping streaks to 14 are unpriced risk once a cop converts beacons) made quantitative. Pool: the reference heuristic with and without walls, the greedy chaser, and a random walker; fitness = mean survival rate, seeds 401..416, disjoint from the DoD seeds (1..32) and the reference-GA seeds (201..248). Weights land in ga_weights_bookv1.json and deploy ONLY via config review - never to the sparring host, never automatically.
